answer: Rank identities by trust flowing from a small set of verified seeds: run short random walks over the graph of real payments and collaborations, scoring each identity by how often walks land on it. Honest agents sit close to the seeds, fed by many genuine edges like an oasis fed by many streams. A sybil farm attaches through only a few attack edges, so its fakes strand far out in the dune, rarely reached. To lift a thousand fakes, the attacker must buy thousands of genuine links, and each new edge ripples the ranking — the farm pays per link while one honest agent rides the walks for free.
